Order.title: Simba Order
Order.description: Represents a purchase made by a user through the Simba 2.0 app.

userId.description: The unique ID of the user who placed the order.

userEmail.description: The email of the user who placed the order.

items.description: The list of product items purchased.

totalPrice.description: The total cost of the order in RWF.

selectedBranchId.description: The ID of the branch selected for pickup/fulfillment.

deliveryLocation.description: The full address provided by the user.

paymentMethod.description: The method used to pay for the order.

phone.description: Optional phone number for mobile money transactions.

status.description: The current status of the order.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp indicating order creation.
